assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production small UI illustration for the Toutes (all cards) collection filter in Sylve, an original woodland fantasy card game.
Primary request: one compact fan of four ornate collectible card backs, clearly recognizable as a card collection at 25 pixels. The overlapping card backs show the four existing rarity colors: sage and silver, sapphire blue, amethyst purple, and warm amber gold. The front card has a single bold embossed golden leaf emblem in a simple diamond. Restrained botanical corner engraving and thick beveled edges.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted 2D storybook fantasy inventory art, tactile metal and enamel, softly worn gold, fine dark contour, matching a painted golden sword and emerald-inlaid wooden bow in a warm walnut and forest-green game interface.
Composition/framing: square canvas, one centered isolated fan filling 88 percent of the canvas, all card corners fully visible with a small transparent margin, clean strong silhouette. Broad details readable at very small sizes.
Lighting/mood: warm top-left highlights, deep but clear shadows, subtle dimensional shading.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background.
Constraints: only the compact group of card backs; no lettering, no text, no numbers, no characters, no UI panel, no surrounding frame, no ground plane, no background, no glow cloud, no watermark, no additional objects.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production small building-type UI illustration for Sylve, an original woodland fantasy card game, used in the Bâtiments collection filter and building card labels.
Primary request: a single compact enchanted woodland stone watchtower, a clear readable building silhouette at 25 pixels. One stout cream-stone tower with a broad steep deep emerald-teal pointed roof, small warm amber arched doorway, two restrained glowing windows, a thick old-brass roof rim and a small bold golden leaf crest above the doorway. Only a few small moss accents on the actual stone base.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted 2D storybook fantasy inventory art, tactile slightly worn stone and aged golden metal, fine dark contour, matching painted golden sword and emerald-inlaid wooden bow icons in a warm walnut and forest-green game interface. Broad simple shapes, elegant dimensional highlights, no excessive tiny architectural detail.
Composition/framing: square canvas, one centered isolated tower seen nearly front-on with subtle three-quarter depth, filling 88 percent of the canvas, complete roof tip and base visible with a small transparent margin, strong broad silhouette.
Lighting/mood: warm top-left highlights, soft emerald ambient shadows, cozy woodland magic.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background.
Constraints: exactly one building; no scenery, no landscape, no ground plane, no trees, no surrounding objects, no cards, no characters, no frame, no UI panel, no text, no letters, no numbers, no glow cloud, no watermark.
